{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display basic info
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Check first 10 values of revenue
print(f"Number of rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique channels: {df['channel'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique segments: {df['customer_segment'].unique()}")
print(f"Number of 'new' customers: {df[df['customer_segment'] == 'new'].shape[0]}")
print(f"Number of 'paid_search' customers: {df[df['channel'] == 'paid_search'].shape[0]}")
print(f"Number of 'new' customers in 'paid_search': {df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')].shape[0]}")

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_count = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_count}")"}
